body:
Implement slice 2 of the approved context-rot handoff design (docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md). Slice 1 (@adlc/context-handoff pure helpers + contract tests) shipped in #448. This ticket adds the operator/host CLI surface that adapters and humans will call — no harness adapters (slices 4–6) and no build-gate migration (slice 3).

Binding design: docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md and .adlc/specs/context-rot-handoff.md (keep in sync; do not weaken slice-1 semantics).

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. CLI binary for `@adlc/context-handoff` exposing subcommands: `write`, `resume`, `bypass`, `repair`, `unlock` (and `--help`), dispatched as `adlc handoff <subcommand>` via packages/cli/lib/registry.mjs.
2. `write`: create/refresh a final handoff checkpoint + ensure deny marker for the current session (session id required); dry-run by default; `--write` mutates. Manifest-record a durable evidence entry when recording (gate name consistent with package, e.g. `context-handoff-write`).
3. `resume`: other-session consume path — require final with non-null content_hash; sign/record `context-handoff-resume`; set deny record status=consumed; write resume-auth cache; same-session consume exits 2.
4. `bypass`: TTY+key one-shot. Bound bypass (`--session <id>`) lifts D2 for bound denies only; unbound (`--unbound-reason=<non-empty>`) authorizes unbound/null-hash and may clear D0 store-unavailable / D3 invalid_record per binding spec. Record bypass to manifest. Refuse silent bypass without durable record when key required.
5. `repair`: privileged host/TTY only — update open deny `ticket_id`+`content_hash` from a successful final; may create/refresh final; manifest-record `context-handoff-repair`. Document that agent Shell under deny must not invoke this (enforcement is slices 4–6).
6. `unlock`: reclaim lock only when PID dead + same host + full `{pid,started_at,host,nonce}` match; otherwise exit 2.
7. Contract/integration tests that drive the real binary (not mocked CLI output shapes) covering happy paths + same-session resume reject + unlock mismatch + bypass bound vs unbound distinction.
8. Docs: update apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/context-handoff.mdx with CLI usage.

=== ACCEPTANCE ===
- `adlc handoff --help` (or `handoff --help` via package bin) lists write|resume|bypass|repair|unlock. Verification: `node packages/context-handoff/bin/handoff.mjs --help` exits 0 and prints those subcommands.
- Registry wires `handoff` tool. Verification: `node --test packages/cli/test/dispatch.test.mjs` (or package dispatch suite) asserts `isTool('handoff') === true`.
- write dry-run makes no files; write --write creates deny marker under `.adlc/handoffs/denies/` and updates `.adlc/.deny-store`. Verification: `node --test packages/context-handoff/cli-test/cli-write.test.mjs`
- resume other-session consumes open deny (status=consumed) and same-session exits 2. Verification: `node --test packages/context-handoff/cli-test/cli-resume.test.mjs`
- bypass bound vs unbound matches mutation-gate semantics (bound cannot authorize null-ticket; unbound with reason can). Verification: `node --test packages/context-handoff/cli-test/cli-bypass.test.mjs`
- unlock refuses live PID / nonce mismatch (exit 2); dead PID + full match reclaims. Verification: `node --test packages/context-handoff/cli-test/cli-unlock.test.mjs`
- Binding specs still lint clean. Verification: `adlc spec-lint docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md`
- Package + docs suite green. Verification: `node --test packages/context-handoff/{test,cli-test}/*.test.mjs` and `node --test apps/docs/test/toolkit-packages.test.mjs`

allow-suppression: none


=== ARTIFACT PATHS (binding for this slice) ===
- Final checkpoint: `.adlc/handoffs/finals/<session_id>.json` with fields `{schema:1, session_id, ticket_id, content_hash, written_at, host}` (content_hash non-null after successful write).
- Deny marker: `.adlc/handoffs/denies/<session_id>.json` (existing slice-1 ensureDenyMarker).
- Deny-store sentinel: `.adlc/.deny-store` (existing).
- Resume-auth cache: `.adlc/handoffs/<session_id>.resume-auth.json` — signed gate-manifest-verifiable payload carrying `{ticket_id, content_hash}` for authorized(); unverifiable ⇒ treat as absent.
- Lock file: `.adlc/handoffs/<session_id>.lock` with `{pid, started_at, host, nonce}`.
- Bypass/repair/write/resume that require durable evidence use ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY via gate-manifest; missing key ⇒ refuse mutate (exit 1), never silent success.
- "TTY+key" means operator-invoked CLI with signing key available; do not require isatty() for v1 unit tests (injectable).

Out of scope: Pi/CC/Cursor/Copilot/agy/OpenCode adapters; build-gate isHardDegraded migration; Proven CI; signed per-deny ledger beyond existing sentinel; host compactors.
title: context-handoff slice 2: CLI write/resume/bypass/repair/unlock
